speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing mental status changes; to help me understand your condition, please tell me when these symptoms first started and if you have a history of fever or recent head trauma.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Toxicology_Screen

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Mental status changes. I also have Increased confusion, Lethargy.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Patient has a history of hypertension, managed with medication. No other significant medical history is reported. Social history: Patient is a smoker with a 30 pack-year history. Drinks alcohol socially. No illicit drug use is reported.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies headache, seizure, vision changes, chest pain, dyspnea, nausea, vomiting, recent illness, or fever. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Gastroenteritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
You mentioned a previous diagnosis of gastroenteritis, but your primary complaint is mental status changes. Can you describe exactly how your mental status has altered, such as confusion, delirium, or altered consciousness?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_CT

speaker: Doctor
text:
The test results for your blood work and the initial brain imaging are normal, which is concerning since there is no obvious infection or structural bleed. However, the CT scan only evaluates acute bleeding and major strokes; does the mental status change fluctuate throughout the day, and do you have any new onset tremors or muscle weakness?

REQUEST TEST: Ammonia_Level
REQUEST TEST: Cerebrospinal_Fluid_Analysis

speaker: Doctor
text:
The initial measurements show normal readings, which does not rule out metabolic or toxic causes for your mental status changes. Do you have a history of liver disease, alcohol use disorder, or recent exposure to carbon monoxide or other toxins?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Ammonia_Level

speaker: Doctor
text:
The repeated normal results for liver function, ammonia, and brain imaging make metabolic encephalopathy and structural causes unlikely. Do you have any history of substance abuse, particularly alcohol or sedatives, or have you had recent exposure to pesticides or industrial solvents?

REQUEST TEST: Urine_Tox_Screen
REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_B12_Level

speaker: Doctor
text:
The toxicology screen and Vitamin B12 levels are now confirmed as normal, effectively ruling out most common toxic, metabolic, and nutritional causes of your mental status changes. Do you have a history of autoimmune disorders, such as lupus or thyroid disease, or have you noticed any skin rashes, joint pain, or sensitivity to sunlight?

REQUEST TEST: Antinuclear_Antibody (ANA)
REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone (TSH)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Psychiatric Disorder (Depression or Anxiety) with secondary cognitive impairment.
